title: Observation
description: The atomic record of The Envelope. Who said what, about what, when, from what source, with what evidence and what standing. Observations are only ever added: a correction is a new observation that supersedes an older one, and the older one stays in the history.

envelopes.description: Every envelope this observation is evidence for. One observation can serve several levels at once.

about.description: Actors or things inside the envelope (character ids, 'elders', 'diorama').

stratum.description: Time stratum: what is depicted, when it was made, later observations, the present.

claim.description: The statement, in plain words. For an absence: what is unknown.

absence.description: Required when kind is 'absence': why it is unknown.

ref.description: Citation, file or record. Never invented.

evidence.description: Axis 1: how well the claim is supported.

standing.description: Axis 2: whose knowledge it is to speak to. Never merged with evidence. Defined per envelope.

grantedBy.description: Who recognised this standing; empty when self-declared.

tkLabels.description: Local Contexts Traditional Knowledge Labels, once set with community bodies.

supersedes.description: id of the observation this one corrects or replaces.
